innovations.title: Live Telemetry Dashboard
innovations.description: We stream real-time robot state — pose, sensor values, PID error, and motor output — to FTC Dashboard and a field overlay. Instead of guessing why a mechanism misbehaved, we watch the data live and replay logged runs in the pit. This turned debugging from a guessing game into a data-driven process.

innovations.title: Optical Odometry
innovations.description: Precise position tracking that resists wheel slip, fused with the IMU for reliable heading.

innovations.title: No-Recompile Tuning
innovations.description: PID gains and path constants are editable live, cutting a full tuning cycle from an afternoon to minutes.

innovations.title: Season-Reusable Architecture
innovations.description: Our subsystem and control framework carries over year to year. Each season starts from a proven foundation instead of a blank slate — so early-season time goes into strategy and mechanisms, not rebuilding the software base.

innovations.title: AprilTag Alignment
innovations.description: Vision-based pose correction that eliminates odometry drift and enables precise scoring alignment.

innovations.title: Run Logging & Replay
innovations.description: Every autonomous run is logged and replayable, so a failure at competition can be diagnosed from the data.
